newsitem.title: USA: Republic votes to triple shr to 1.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Republic votes to triple shr to 1.5 bln.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc shareholders voted on Tuesday to triple the authorized common shares to 1.5 billion, which top executives said would allow more acquisitions and an eventual 2-for-1 split of Republic stock.

Republic Chariman Wayne Huizenga told the company's annual shareholders meeting that Republic now had about 400 million shares outstanding and that was likely to increase soon to about 450 million or more.
"We want to split the stock 2-for-1. We need 500 million to do that, " Huizenga said.
Huizenga also said the company's board of directors would have likely voted on Tuesday for a stock split if Republic's share price had been in the 40s.
Republic's high-flying shares have been off their all time highs in recent months and now trade at about 27.
"If the stock had been at 40 we might have had that discussion at our board meeting today," Huizenga said.
"Perhaps when we get back to 40 we will look at it," he said.
